German Language and Culture

Radboud University

← Back to search
About this programme

A reliable curriculum comparison is currently unavailable. The external curriculum has unresolved requirements; no complete degree pathway is certified here.

Study German language, literature and culture, including linguistics, Dutch–German relations and experience in a German-speaking country. The degree develops advanced German proficiency and academic research skills.

The published requirements do not yet establish a complete ordinary-route curriculum that can be used for a reliable programme comparison. The supported components are shown below; UCR alternatives are withheld.

Academic year: 2026–2027

External pathway: Ordinary programme: supported components only

The degree is 180 EC. The list below accounts for 165 distinct EC because three courses appear in both the second- and third-year requirements. Clarification is needed about the remaining 15 EC. This is a partial list, not a complete degree pathway.
